segment.source: In accordion mode, only one panel can be expanded at a time.
segment.target: Em accordion modo, somente um painel pode ser expanded at a hora.
A sem borda estilo de Recolhimento.

segment.source: By default, any number of panels can be expanded at a time. The first panel is expanded in this example.
segment.target: Por padrão, any number de painéis pode ser expanded at a hora. O primeiro painel é expanded em este exemplo.

segment.source: Specify the trigger area of collapsible by collapsible.

segment.target: Por favor definir personalizado cabeçalho margins e conteúdo espaçamento.

segment.source: The expand icon can be placed in front or in the back.
segment.target: O expand ícone pode ser placed em front ou em o voltar.

segment.source: Collapse is nested inside the Collapse.
segment.target: Recolhimento é nested inside o Recolhimento.

segment.source: You can hide the arrow icon by passing IsShowExpandIcon={False} to CollapsePanel component.
segment.target: Você pode hide o arrow ícone por passing IsShowExpandIcon={False} para CollapsePanel component.

segment.source: A dog is a type of domesticated animal. Known for its loyalty and faithfulness, it can be found as a welcome guest in many households across the world.
segment.target: A dog é a tipo de domesticated animal. Known para its loyalty e faithfulness, isso pode ser found as a welcome guest em many households across o world.

segment.source: Collapse organizes dense information into panels. It supports accordion behavior, nested panels, borderless and ghost styles, custom spacing, icon placement, and icon-only trigger mode.
segment.target: Recolhimento organizes denso informação into painéis. Isso oferece suporte accordion behavior, nested painéis, sem borda e ghost styles, personalizado espaçamento, ícone posicionamento, e ícone-somente gatilho modo.

segment.source: Stack related content sections that can expand or collapse independently.
segment.target: Stack related conteúdo sections que pode expand ou recolhimento independently.

segment.source: Body element with padding, color, background color and other styles for panel content area display
segment.target: Body element com padding, color, background color e outro styles for panel content area display

segment.source: Header element with flex layout, padding, color, line-height, cursor style, transition animations and other interactive styles for panel headers
segment.target: Header element com flex layout, padding, color, line-height, cursor style, transition animations e outro interactive styles for panel headers

segment.source: Icon element with font size, transition animations, rotation transforms and other styles and animations for expand/collapse arrows
segment.target: Icon element com font size, transition animations, rotation transforms e outro styles e animations for expand/collapse arrows

segment.source: Use owner-scoped selectors and Collapse property selectors to customize the published Semantic Parts.
segment.target: Use owner-scoped selectors e Collapse property selectors para customize o published Semantic Parts.

segment.source: Root element with border, border-radius, background color and container styles that control the overall layout and appearance of collapse panels
segment.target: Root element com border, border-radius, background color e container styles that control o overall layout e appearance of collapse panels

segment.source: Title element with flex auto layout and margin styles for title text layout and typography
segment.target: Title element com flex auto layout e margin styles for title text layout e typography

segment.source: Ant Design supports a default collapse size as well as a large and small size. If a large or small collapse is desired, set the size property to either large or small respectively. Omit the size property for a collapse with the default size.
segment.target: Ant Design oferece suporte a padrão recolhimento tamanho as well as a grande e pequeno tamanho. Se a grande ou pequeno recolhimento é desired, definir o tamanho propriedade para either grande ou pequeno respectively. Omit o tamanho propriedade para a recolhimento com o padrão tamanho.
